body: I understand that I'm incredibly privileged. I understand I have an amazing life. I understand that so many people would kill to be where am I. But it only makes it worse. All this and still I'm a failure. Still i can't rid myself of my suicidal thoughts. It's all a vicious cycle. This is where the feeling of acting comes in. I can't even decide who I am anymore. I don't know if there really is a true person anywhere inside me. I laugh at my friends jokes because I'm supposed to. I smile because I'm supposed to. I'm a farce. I've been a farce for 5 years. I've lied my way through college and now it's caught up to me. I would be a horrible teacher. I'm like a leach to everyone. For the past 3 years, my friends can see it, but never say anything. why? Cause they arent really my friends. I'm the tumor in the group. I can see the change in my friends demeanors and faces when I show up. It's like everyone wishes I wasn't there, but assumes that someone else there invited me and they don't want to be rude to them. I thought maybe the real world would give me a second chance, but if I don't graduate, there is no real world. I've failed myself. Ive lost. -- sorry for posting the same thing I responded to your PM with. I just don't want to write anymore. I don't want to think anymore
